description: List the bridge VLAN table (interface/bridge/vlan) on a MikroTik router: per entry the bridge, vlan-ids, configured tagged/untagged ports, the current-tagged/current-untagged ports RouterOS actually applies, and whether it is dynamic. Filter by bridge and by a VLAN id (matched inside ranges and lists), with pagination.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

vlanId.description: Only entries whose vlan-ids include this VLAN (ranges and lists are expanded)

name: list_bridge_vlans
title: List Bridge VLANs
